name: newswatcher
description: Watch RSS feeds, match your topics, and deliver an LLM-summarized digest, powered by the newswatcher package

interface.shortDescription: Watch RSS feeds and deliver an LLM-summarized topic digest
interface.longDescription: Run a newswatcher poll from a conversation: collect new articles from your configured RSS or crawl sources, match them to the topics you defined, summarize the matches with an LLM, and deliver one topic-grouped digest by email or chat.
